facts.value: An online induction will be run by your faculty during the 10 day-window before your programme begins.
Induction will provide you with all the information you need to start your programme, including a timetable and expectations for each semester.
An on-campus orientation will take place on the Friday before week 1 of the semester for many Autumn programmes.
You will gain access to UL's Virtual Learning Environment (VLE) called Brightspace.
myUL is UL’s app for students, helping you stay informed, supported and connected on campus.
The app includes your timetable, an interactive campus map, Clubs & Societies, and access to key student supports.
Details on how to download and log into the myUL app are available at myUL App.
